title: The paired run's default cache path is host-neutral, resolved when called, and fails early when unwritable
summary: paired.py resolves its cache from RPG_MEASURE_CACHE, then XDG, then ~/.cache/rpg-measure when called, and refuses an unusable root before any arm starts.

title: Five latent world-assembly paths that no corpus world exercises today
summary: Disabled module refs no longer raise a false missing-module error, a duplicate module ref is refused before any merge, order is documented, non-latent items split out, WorldProceduralGenerator kept.
